title: Machine learning
tagline: Derive it, code it from scratch, then compare with the library.
intro: Model-first: each lesson starts from a model you can picture and pulls in the probability, statistics and calculus it needs as a detour. Every result is derived in full, with figures you can move.

1.title: Learning from data
1.blurb: Linear regression, gradient descent and the delta rule, logistic regression.

2.title: Making models honest
2.blurb: Train and test splits, regularisation, feature scaling, softmax, SGD and Adam, metrics.

3.title: Trees and boosting
3.blurb: A side branch: decision trees, random forests, gradient boosting.

4.title: Neural networks
4.blurb: Neurons, backpropagation, CNNs, attention and transformers.

5.title: Reinforcement learning
5.blurb: Bandits, Bellman, Q-learning, policy gradients, AlphaZero.
